title: WaterColor 1735 E. County Hwy 30A #305
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands.- 2 adult bikes provided- Jetted Tub- Balcony- Recently renovated in 2020- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Guests will feel spoiled by this fabulous location on the 3rd floor in the heart of Watercolor’s Town Center. Unit #305 is a renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom WaterColor condo that sleeps 6 and enjoys views of the Beach District, 30A, a sliver of the Gulf. The luxurious Beach Club, beach access, and restaurants are steps away. This condo has sandy-feet-friendly wood floors and a cozy, family-friendly aesthetic. A bright and cheery kitchen has granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and everything guests need to prepare a delicious meal or quick snack before heading out to the beach. Guests may opt to dine at an adjacent dining table that seats 6 or outside on a wonderful balcony overlooking Scenic 30A. A plush queen sleeper sofa and loveseat surround an armoire that conceals a 32” TV and offers a varied selection of books for rainy day reading. French doors flood the room with natural light and open to the furnished balcony, complete with a dining table and oversized armchair lounge chair. It’s the perfect spot to people-watch during the day or relax in the evening with a good meal and the sound of crashing waves in the distance. Opposite the kitchen and living area are 2 guest bedrooms. The primary bedroom offers a king bed, a comfortable reading chair, smart TV with DVD, direct access to the balcony through French doors, a bathroom with a large walk-in shower, a soaking tub with jets, and a custom-built closet. A guest bedroom has 2 twin beds, lovely views of tall pine and oaks along the park, and shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with the living area. Exploring WaterColor’s parks, nature trails, community pools, Camp WaterColor, and the BoatHouse is easy on 2 included adult bikes. Guests are centrally located at Town Center #305 and can also walk to Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park. With this location and the many comforts of home, #305 will book quickly. Book your next beach escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/TubGuest Bedroom: Two Twins: Shared Bathroom with Shower/TubLiving Room: Queen SleeperWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499 acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
